title: Zesty Chewy German Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional German dish featuring pork dumplings with a zesty and sour flavor, made with Shaoxing wine and a deglaze method, perfect for a low-sodium diet. This dish is energizing and delicious, with a chewy texture from the dumplings.
instructions: Combine the ground pork, Shaoxing wine, flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl and mix well.
Add the beaten egg to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Fold in the chopped onion and parsley into the pork mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Bring the low-sodium chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Using a spoon, drop the pork mixture into the boiling broth, making about 12 dumplings.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the pot with a slotted spoon and place them on a plate.
Deglaze the pot with a little bit of Shaoxing wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Serve the dumplings hot, spooning some of the deglazed sauce over the top of each dumpling.
